name: garage-functions
description: Cloud Functions do Garage Power Lab

scripts.checar: node scripts/copiar-regras-gestao.mjs && tsc && node lib/checar.js && node lib/checar-conquistas.js && node lib/checar-box.js && node lib/checar-catalogo.js && node lib/checar-hiit.js && node lib/checar-cross.js && node lib/checar-pix.js && node lib/checar-pix-http.js && node lib/checar-presenca.js && node lib/checar-ugym.js && node lib/checar-evolucao-ia.js && node lib/checar-caixas.js && node lib/checar-quadro-publicar.js && node lib/checar-agentes.js && node lib/checar-rotinas.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.checar:emulador:conquistas: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore --project demo-garage "node testes-conquistas-emulador.cjs"
scripts.checar:emulador:caixas: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-garage "node testes-caixas-emulador.cjs"
